name: Gaty Promotion
author: Gaty Tech

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Gaty Promotion.
  3. Open Gaty Promotion from the WordPress dashboard sidebar.
  4. Create promotions, upload their images, select their sizes, then save.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Load all public and admin CSS/JavaScript using the WordPress enqueue API.

2.1.9

  • Fixed output escaping for the optional new-tab link attributes.
sections.description:
Create multiple promotional popups for a WordPress or WooCommerce site.

Features

  • Create and activate any number of promotions.
  • Upload/select every promotion image directly from WordPress Media Library.
  • Select standard popup widths: 400px, 560px, 720px, 900px, or 1000px.
  • Choose whether each promotion appears once per visitor, or on every page load and refresh.
  • Show a random promotion on each page load, or show all active promotions in sequence.
  • Each promotion can have its own title, content, image, button, link, and new-tab setting.
  • Disable or delete individual promotions from the Gaty Promotion page.
  • Includes a direct Settings link under Gaty Promotion on the WordPress Plugins page, alongside WordPress’s native Activate/Deactivate and Delete controls.
